successor: Tukulor (Umarian) empire of al-Hajj Umar Tal
source2: M. Grosz-Ngate, 'Bamana', Worldmark Encyclopedia of Cultures and Daily Life (Gale), via Encyclopedia.com - https://www.encyclopedia.com/humanities/encyclopedias-almanacs-transcripts-and-maps/bamana
